name: kaldrax-memory-retrieval-v1
description: Small local regression set for project engineering memory retrieval.

memories.content: Rule: Every memory lookup is constrained by project identifier to prevent cross-project disclosure.
Decision: SQLite persists local memory records across process restarts without a hosted database.
Rule: The recursive engine imposes finite iteration budgets to stop runaway retries.
Rule: Provider credentials are not written to persisted run reports or project memory.
memories.summary: Keep API secrets out of durable records.

memories.content: Decision: Newly extracted semantic knowledge remains pending until a human reviews and approves it.

queries.query: how do we stop one codebase seeing another project's memories
what local database keeps notes after the app restarts
prevent the agent from retrying forever
where are provider API keys stored in history
who must accept proposed reusable facts
